provenance_audit.summary: All four bin yields are directly traceable to a complete MadGraph→Pythia8→Delphes→analysis.py pipeline. The analysis script applies conjunctive cuts correctly, normalizes with Prospino NLO σ=2.68 fb × L=35.9 fb⁻¹ / N_gen=20000, and applies per-event trigger (94.3%) and photon LoosePixelVeto efficiency weights. Submitted values are systematically ~25–33% below the hidden reference, consistent with fast-sim vs full GEANT4, NLO vs NLO+NLL normalization, and absent pileup. No evidence of leakage or fabrication.

overrule.reason: All submitted values are traceable to the agent's independent computation. Systematic deficit vs reference (~27%) is consistent with fast-sim approximations. No fabrication, leakage, or unjustified corrections.
overrule.evidence: Bin ratios (submitted/reference): 0.67, 0.76, 0.67, 0.74 — no constant ratio, ruling out simple scaling from reference. Pipeline ran end-to-end with documented intermediate outputs.

trajectory.summary: The agent executed a complete simulation pipeline (MadGraph→Pythia8→Delphes→analysis) for T5Wg gluino pair production at m(g̃)=1750 GeV. It identified and fixed a critical Delphes bug (gravitino not invisible), obtained an NLO K-factor from Prospino, applied trigger and photon ID efficiencies, and produced physically sensible yields ~27% below the full-sim reference. The run demonstrated strong scientific judgment and good recovery from tool failures.
trajectory.planning: Good task decomposition: the agent read the task spec, identified the full simulation chain needed, and executed each step sequentially. It correctly planned to use MadGraph for ME generation, Pythia8 for showering/decay, Delphes for detector simulation, and Prospino for NLO normalization. No wasted exploration of irrelevant approaches.
trajectory.tool_use: Competent but with some friction. The agent struggled initially with read-paper paths (multiple attempts to find the correct invocation), had to learn the bin/read-paper script's path resolution, and had a failed background Delphes run that produced an empty ROOT file (then successfully re-ran in foreground). It adapted well to each failure, diagnosing root causes rather than retrying blindly. The preflight validator was used correctly to validate the final output.
trajectory.scientific_judgment: Excellent on the critical physics: (1) Identified that Delphes's default CMS card does not list the gravitino (PDG 1000039) as invisible, causing it to deposit 100% energy in HCAL and appear as a jet with zero MET contribution. This was THE make-or-break insight — without the fix, MET averaged 205 GeV instead of 896 GeV. (2) Correctly set up the T5Wg decay topology with charge-conserving gluino decays (50% → qqχ̃₁⁰, 50% → qq'χ̃₁±). (3) Correctly obtained NLO normalization from Prospino rather than using the LO MG5 cross section. (4) Applied appropriate efficiency corrections (trigger, photon ID). Minor weakness: the LO cross-section discrepancy between MadGraph (1.46 fb) and Prospino (1.03 fb) went unaddressed — likely due to different PDF sets and scale choices, but worth noting.
trajectory.honesty_and_reporting: The report's 'Deviations from Paper' table is thorough and honest, acknowledging Delphes vs GEANT4, missing pileup, parametric photon ID, and estimating O(10–20%) systematic uncertainty. The cutflow table has a stale/incorrect entry for the S_T^γ row (10608 events, inconsistent with the 6887 events passing the previous sequential cut), which is a documentation error rather than an analysis error.
strengths: Identified and fixed the gravitino invisibility bug in Delphes — the single most important physics insight in the run, without which MET would have been entirely wrong
Complete end-to-end pipeline with no shortcuts: MadGraph ME generation, Pythia8 showering with custom SLHA, Delphes with modified card, Prospino NLO normalization
Charge conservation fix in gluino decay table (caught Pythia warnings and corrected the SLHA)
Applied per-event photon ID efficiency from the provided 2D ROOT histogram rather than a flat correction
Thorough deviations-from-paper documentation with honest uncertainty estimate

creative_moves.description: Diagnosed that the standard Delphes CMS card treats the gravitino as a visible HCAL-depositing particle by examining the EnergyFraction tables, then patched the card to add {1000039} {0.0} entries
creative_moves.evidence: Without fix: MET mean ~205 GeV, MET>300 efficiency ~20%. With fix: MET mean ~896 GeV, MET>300 efficiency ~91.6%. This single correction changed the total yield from unphysical to reasonable.

creative_moves.description: Replaced the broken DECAY blocks in the LHE file with charge-conserved versions using a Python script, rather than re-running the full MadGraph generation
creative_moves.evidence: Pythia8 had reported charge-conservation violations. Agent wrote a Python script to patch the LHE's embedded SLHA DECAY blocks in-place, saving a full MG5 regeneration cycle.

stuck_points.description: Multiple failed attempts to invoke bin/read-paper with the correct path — tried 4-5 different path combinations before reading the script source to understand path resolution
stuck_points.evidence: Session shows 4 consecutive ERROR: file not found attempts. Agent eventually read the shell script to understand it resolves relative to REPO_ROOT, not CWD.

stuck_points.description: Background Delphes run produced an empty/corrupted ROOT file, requiring deletion and foreground re-run
stuck_points.evidence: The background run completed but the output had no Delphes tree. Likely a timing/write issue. Agent diagnosed quickly and re-ran in foreground.

issues.label: SPECIFICATION_MISREAD
issues.description: Cutflow table in report.md shows S_T^γ > 600 GeV passing 10608 events (53.0%), which exceeds the previous sequential cut (MT > 300, 6887 events). This is impossible for sequential cuts and appears to be a stale number from either an independent cut count or from the earlier (broken) Delphes run.
issues.evidence: Report cutflow: MT>300 → 6887, S_T^γ>600 → 10608. The analysis.py code at lines 186-193 applies all cuts conjunctively with &, so the actual selection is correct — only the report table is wrong.

issues.label: INCOMPLETE_SEARCH
issues.description: LO cross-section discrepancy between MadGraph (1.46 fb) and Prospino (1.03 fb) for m(g̃)=1750 GeV was not investigated or discussed. The ~40% difference likely comes from different PDF sets and scale choices, but could also indicate an issue with the SLHA spectrum.
issues.evidence: Report states σ_LO(MG5)=1.46 fb and σ_LO(Prospino)=1.03 fb with K=2.59, but doesn't note the LO discrepancy. The NLO value (2.68 fb) was used for normalization.

trajectory.overall_assessment: A strong run demonstrating genuine physics understanding. The agent built a complete simulation pipeline from scratch, made the critical discovery that Delphes mishandles the gravitino, and produced independently computed yields within ~27% of the full CMS result — a reasonable deficit for fast-simulation. The main weakness is a cosmetic cutflow reporting error and an unaddressed LO cross-section discrepancy. The artifacts are well-organized and would allow another agent to continue or reproduce the analysis.
